items.title: Why Bunge Global (BG) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of global agribusiness company Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) jumped 2.8% in the afternoon session after the company announced an agreement to sell two of its Brazilian sugarcane mills to COFCO International. According to StreetInsider, Bunge will divest the Rio Vermelho and Nova Unialco mills located in the state of São Paulo, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
